successCriteria.description: PgBalanceRepository satisfies the IBalanceRepository interface with all 6 methods: findByEmployeeId, findByEmployeeIdAndLeaveType, findByEmployeeIdAndFiscalYear, create, update, and deductDays — each using parameterized queries against the pg Pool from src/shared/db/connection and mapping snake_case rows to camelCase Balance entities.

PgBalanceRepository.deductDays atomically decrements remaining_days, increments used_days, and sets status to 'exhausted' via a SQL CASE expression when remaining_days - $days <= 0, all within a single UPDATE RETURNING * statement.

BalanceService satisfies the IBalanceService interface: getBalance delegates to repository.findByEmployeeIdAndLeaveType, getBalances delegates to repository.findByEmployeeId, hasSufficientBalance returns true iff remainingDays >= requestedDays (false when balance missing), and deductBalance throws BalanceNotFoundError when balance is missing, InsufficientBalanceError when remainingDays < days, and delegates to repository.deductDays otherwise.

BalanceController exposes two route handlers (getBalance and getBalances) that accept Fastify request/reply, delegate to BalanceService, return 200 with the balance data on success, 404 when balance is null, and 500 on unexpected errors.
balance.routes.ts exports a Fastify plugin function that instantiates PgBalanceRepository → BalanceService → BalanceController and registers the two GET routes.

PgAuditLogRepository satisfies the IAuditLogRepository interface: findByEntity returns logs for a given entityType+entityId ordered by created_at DESC, create inserts and returns the new AuditLog, and findAll builds dynamic WHERE clauses from optional filters (entityType, performedBy, fromDate, toDate) using indexed parameterized placeholders.

All three unit test files exist and pass: balance.repository.spec.ts (mocks pg Pool, covers all 6 repository methods including deductDays exhaustion), balance.service.spec.ts (mocks IBalanceRepository, covers all 4 service methods including error paths), and audit-log.repository.spec.ts (mocks pg Pool, covers all 3 repository methods including combined filter queries).

constraints: All database access MUST go through the repository layer (GP-001). BalanceService and BalanceController must never call pool.query directly — only through IBalanceRepository / IAuditLogRepository.
All SQL queries MUST use parameterized placeholders ($1, $2, …). No string interpolation of user-supplied values into SQL.
Row mapping from snake_case DB columns to camelCase entity fields MUST be done via dedicated mapRowToBalance / mapRowToAuditLog functions. No inline column renaming in query methods.
The balance routes plugin MUST NOT be registered in src/app.ts during this phase — integration is deferred to a follow-up phase per the architecture document.
outOfScope: Registering the balance routes plugin in src/app.ts — explicitly deferred to a follow-up integration phase per the architecture document.
RBAC enforcement (requireRole middleware) on balance endpoints — the controller and routes are wired but auth guards are deferred to the integration phase when the auth middleware is available.

entityInvariants.invariant: remainingDays = totalEntitlement - usedDays must hold after every state change. deductDays is the only operation that mutates usedDays/remainingDays; it must decrement remainingDays and increment usedDays by the same amount atomically.

status transitions: active → exhausted when remainingDays reaches 0 or below. The transition is computed in SQL (CASE WHEN remaining_days - $days <= 0 THEN 'exhausted' ELSE status END) and must never be set to 'exhausted' while remainingDays > 0.
Every AuditLog record is immutable after creation — no update or delete methods exist on IAuditLogRepository. The create method is the only write path.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns null when the balance row does not exist (id not found). The caller (BalanceService) is responsible for translating null into BalanceNotFoundError.

Throws BalanceNotFoundError (code: NOT_FOUND) when no balance exists for the given employeeId+leaveType or when deductDays returns null. Throws InsufficientBalanceError (code: INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE) when remainingDays < days. Accepts a pre-calculated day count; the service does NOT compute days from dates — that responsibility lives in the leave-request module.
Returns false (not an error) when the balance does not exist. Returns false when remainingDays < requestedDays. Returns true only when remainingDays >= requestedDays.

All filter parameters are optional. When no filters are provided, returns all audit logs ordered by created_at DESC. Dynamic WHERE clause construction uses indexed placeholders ($1, $2, …) built incrementally.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: PgBalanceRepository must import pool from src/shared/db/connection (not create its own Pool instance).
PgAuditLogRepository must import pool from src/shared/db/connection (not create its own Pool instance).
Balance entity, IBalanceRepository, IBalanceService, InsufficientBalanceError, and BalanceNotFoundError must be imported from ./balance.model.ts — not redefined.
AuditLog entity, IAuditLogRepository, and AuditLogValidationError must be imported from ./audit-log.model.ts — not redefined.
BalanceStatus enum must be imported from src/shared/types/index.ts — not redefined locally.

integrationPoints.why: Both PgBalanceRepository and PgAuditLogRepository depend on the shared pg Pool for all database operations.

PgBalanceRepository implements IBalanceRepository; BalanceService implements IBalanceService and consumes IBalanceRepository; BalanceController consumes BalanceService. The leave-request module (Phase 3) will consume IBalanceService for balance checks and deductions.
PgAuditLogRepository implements IAuditLogRepository. The leave-request module (Phase 3) will consume IAuditLogRepository to write audit records for all state-changing operations.
The balance routes plugin is exported and ready for registration via app.register(balanceRoutes) in a follow-up integration phase.
